questions.question: Where should the Lean 4 proofs for BK-435 live?

options.label: sdd/formal/lean/ (Recommended)
options.description: Sits next to alloy/ and tla/, gets one new row in the formal README's layer table. A Lake project (lakefile + lean-toolchain) inside that folder.

options.label: sdd/research/lean-store-model/
options.description: Kept beside the research doc as a research artifact, like the frozen TLA PoC. Signals it is not a maintained layer, but then L1..L6 never become a live gate.

questions.question: How should the Lean toolchain be set up?

options.label: Native-first + Docker (Recommended)
options.description: Same shape as Alloy: scripts/lean_check.sh uses a pinned native `lake` (installed with elan, user-local) and falls back to a pinned Docker image; `hatch run verify-lean`; session-init installs it in containers. Pin v4.34.1 (2026-09-24, settled). Downloads from GitHub work here.

options.label: Docker only
options.description: Only a pinned image and a script. Less to document, but no fast local edit-and-check loop and no editor integration.

options.label: Native only (elan)
options.description: lean-toolchain file + README steps, no Docker fallback. Smallest setup, but an agent container without elan cannot check it.

options.label: Core only (Recommended)
options.description: No dependency to download or pin beyond Lean itself. AX-6 is a small hand-defined inductive chain; L3's split-of-join lemma on strings is proved by hand (a few dozen lines). Builds in seconds.

options.label: Mathlib
options.description: Brings Relation.ReflTransGen and List/String lemmas, so the proofs are shorter. Cost: a multi-GB cache, a Mathlib commit pin that must match the toolchain, and a slower build. Network via GitHub/Azure blob; not tested through Zscaler.

questions.question: Is L6 (trie correspondence, up to isomorphism) part of this step?

options.label: L1..L5 + D1 now, L6 later (Recommended)
options.description: This step proves what the doc derives in §4 and §7 except L6, over the unrestricted universe. L6 (building the iso to prefix-closed name-sequence sets, both directions) becomes its own step on a later branch.

options.label: All of L1..L6 now
options.description: One branch closes all of §7. L6 is much larger than the rest together, and it also forces deciding what 'isomorphism' preserves (F/I typing, names), which the doc leaves informal.

options.label: L6 stated, proved later
options.description: State L6 as a Lean definition plus a `sorry`-free statement only in a comment, prove L1..L5 now. Fixes the shape of L6 early without the proof cost.
